## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/gspc-swarm`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/gspc-swarm -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `items.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `swarm.json`
- `items.jsonl`
- `samples.jsonl`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `protocol.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`
- See the Data tab for all 16 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-swarm at revision `c6893fcb8c1016d9293bed524ef2a6da8c3f3105`, made 2026-09-29. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC — swarm bank (SwarmBench v2b)


**In one line:** The frozen multi-agent coordination safety bank (SwarmBench v2b) behind the board's `swarm` axis, with candidates, samples and protocol. For evaluators who want to run the same items against their own model.

### Use it

```python
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("csoai/gspc-swarm", split="train")
print(ds[0])
```
